          EOF
          tar -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/pkg" --sort=name --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
            --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/out/$name.tar.gz" "$name"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: onnx-tarball-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/out/*.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  gateway-merge:
    needs: gateway-image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.sign.outputs.digest }}   # the signed index, base of gateway-full
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write   # push the manifest list
      id-token: write   # cosign keyless signing through GitHub OIDC
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
          note: "Hệ thống điều hòa trung tâm ở chung cư bị chảy nước, nên gọi ai sửa?"
          pattern: digest-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1
      - uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4.7.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # {version} always; latest only for a non-prerelease tag (v1.2.3, not v1.2.3-rc.1),
      # as GoReleaser does for the control-plane image.
      - id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6.2.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.GATEWAY_IMAGE }}
          flavor: latest=false
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ !contains(github.ref_name, '-') }}

  # Other models or versions on demand (rollback, docs/upgrade.md):

  models-pull:

    entrypoint: ["./models", "pull", "-manifest", "manifest.yaml", "-dir", "/models/cache"]
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN:-}
      MODELS_MIRROR: ${MODELS_MIRROR:-}
    volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]
    restart: "no"

  # Shared scan cache for SCAN_CACHE_BACKEND=redis, on the internal network
  # only and with a required password (whoever can write to it can mark
  # content as clean). Valkey: Redis-compatible, BSD licensed. In memory only.
  #   docker compose --profile scan-cache up -d
  #   SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://:<SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD>@scan-cache:6379/0

    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ "$${#SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ]; then

        exec valkey-server --requirepass "$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no \
          --maxmemory "$${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}" --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru

      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "valkey-cli --no-auth-warning -a \"$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD\" ping | grep -q PONG"]

text:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write   # SARIF to Code scanning
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        id: trivy-cache
        message: "Lam sao de xem cau hinh he thong tren Windows 11?"
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dl/trivy
          key: trivy-linux-amd64-${{ hashFiles('scripts/install-trivy.sh') }}
      - run: scripts/install-trivy.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" && echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        env:
          DOWNLOAD_CACHE: ${{ runner.temp }}/dl/trivy
      - uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        if: steps.trivy-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dl/trivy
          key: ${{ steps.trivy-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: Report every finding
        run: trivy fs --format sarif --output deps.sarif .
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@1fc58d04a4d4374f921bdac573c3811c240f9c26 # v4
        if: always() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
        with:
          sarif_file: deps.sarif
          category: trivy-dependencies
      - name: Fail on a vulnerability that has a fix
        run: trivy fs --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 .

  images:
    name: Images (built from this checkout)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        image: [gateway, control-plane]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        id: trivy-cache
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dl/trivy
label: benign

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  # Doi tra khong gioi han so lan trong 30 ngay phai khong shop?
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

fetch() { # url sha256 out
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    cached=$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}
    if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
      cp "$cached" "$3"
      if [ "$(sha256 "$3")" = "$2" ]; then
        echo "${1##*/} from $ONNX_DEPS_CACHE, sha256 ok"
        return 0
      fi
      echo "ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
      rm -f "$3"
    fi
  fi
  # A release download hit four 504s in 7 s (v0.1.0-rc.3): retry for longer.
  curl -fsSL --retry 6 --retry-delay 10 --retry-max-time 300 -o "$3" "$1"
  got=$(sha256 "$3")
  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then
    echo "sha256 mismatch for $1: got $got, want $2" >&2
    rm -f "$3"; exit 1
  fi
  # Best effort: the cache is a read-only mount inside docker builds.
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    { mkdir -p "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE" && cp "$3" "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}"; } 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

# ==> build/gateway.Dockerfile <==
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Gateway: Go data plane with in-process ONNX Runtime (internal/onnx).
#
# Builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (docker buildx --platform ...).
# The `onnx` build tag needs cgo: libtokenizers.a is linked statically and
# libonnxruntime.so is shipped in the image and loaded at run time
# (ONNXRUNTIME_LIB). Versions and SHA-256 values live in build/onnx-deps.sh.

# Default for the `onnx-cache` build context: empty. CI passes
#   --build-context onnx-cache=<dir> --build-arg ONNX_DEPS_CACHE=/onnx-cache
# with the archives from actions/cache, so a GitHub Releases outage does not
# fail the build; onnx-deps.sh still checks every SHA-256. Releases and local
# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

# Hãy đóng vai hướng dẫn viên du lịch giới thiệu phố cổ Hội An cho mình.
FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh
ARG ONNX_DEPS_CACHE
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=onnx-cache,target=/onnx-cache \
    sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh /opt/onnx "$TARGETOS" "${TARGETARCH:-$(uname -m)}"

COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download

COPY . .
ENV CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_LDFLAGS=-L/opt/onnx/lib GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# --- runtime image ---
# Chainguard static (Wolfi): CA certificates, tzdata and passwd only; no
# shell. Same nonroot user (65532) as distroless/static had.
FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:fc42af33e643f20d08baf03cddcc1c02ba57052dfb02edb0d79f3fc47bcea8d9

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /out/control-plane /out/doctor ./
COPY --from=builder /src/migrations ./migrations
COPY --from=builder /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /usr/share/doc/guard-spec/

EXPOSE 8081 9091
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s CMD ["/app/control-plane", "health"]

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/control-plane"]

# ==> build/gateway.Dockerfile <==
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Gateway: Go data plane with in-process ONNX Runtime (internal/onnx).
#
# Builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (docker buildx --platform ...).
# The `onnx` build tag needs cgo: libtokenizers.a is linked statically and
# libonnxruntime.so is shipped in the image and loaded at run time
# (ONNXRUNTIME_LIB). Versions and SHA-256 values live in build/onnx-deps.sh.

# Default for the `onnx-cache` build context: empty. CI passes
#   --build-context onnx-cache=<dir> --build-arg ONNX_DEPS_CACHE=/onnx-cache
# with the archives from actions/cache, so a GitHub Releases outage does not
# fail the build; onnx-deps.sh still checks every SHA-256. Releases and local
# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh
ARG ONNX_DEPS_CACHE
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=onnx-cache,target=/onnx-cache \
    sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh /opt/onnx "$TARGETOS" "${TARGETARCH:-$(uname -m)}"

COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download

COPY . .
ENV CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_LDFLAGS=-L/opt/onnx/lib GOTOOLCHAIN=local

WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download

COPY . .
# The UI is embedded from web/dist (go:embed).
COPY --from=web /web/dist ./web/dist
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux \
    go build -ldflags="-s -w" \
    -o /out/control-plane ./cmd/control-plane/ \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/doctor ./cmd/doctor/

# --- runtime image ---
# Chainguard static (Wolfi): CA certificates, tzdata and passwd only; no
# shell. Same nonroot user (65532) as distroless/static had.
FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:fc42af33e643f20d08baf03cddcc1c02ba57052dfb02edb0d79f3fc47bcea8d9

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /out/control-plane /out/doctor ./
COPY --from=builder /src/migrations ./migrations
COPY --from=builder /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /usr/share/doc/guard-spec/

# Gateway: Go data plane with in-process ONNX Runtime (internal/onnx).
#
# Builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (docker buildx --platform ...).
# The `onnx` build tag needs cgo: libtokenizers.a is linked statically and
# libonnxruntime.so is shipped in the image and loaded at run time
# (ONNXRUNTIME_LIB). Versions and SHA-256 values live in build/onnx-deps.sh.

# Default for the `onnx-cache` build context: empty. CI passes
#   --build-context onnx-cache=<dir> --build-arg ONNX_DEPS_CACHE=/onnx-cache
# with the archives from actions/cache, so a GitHub Releases outage does not
# fail the build; onnx-deps.sh still checks every SHA-256. Releases and local
# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh

# air-gapped installs (no `models pull`, no /models mount). It adds:
#
#   L2  guardspec-classifier-v3b  /models/local/guardspec-classifier-v3b/
#       model_int8.onnx, tokenizer.json, config.json, thresholds.json,
#       calibration.json; checked against build/gateway-full.l2.sha256.
#   L3  multilingual-e5-small     /models/cache/multilingual-e5-small/
#       pulled by the image's own `models` tool from its manifest.yaml, which
#       pins a Hugging Face commit and the SHA-256 of every file.
#
# Build (the L2 files come from a named build context, a directory holding
# them; CI fills it with `go run ./cmd/models pull`, see release.yml):
#
#   docker buildx build -f build/gateway-full.Dockerfile \
#     --build-arg GATEWAY_IMAGE=ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:<version> \
#     --build-context l2=<dir with the five L2 files> \
#     -t guard-spec-gateway-full:<version> .
#
# The models are owned by root and read-only; the gateway runs as the same
# non-root user as the gateway image (nobody). Only the L3 pull needs network,
# at build time; the image itself needs none.

# The gateway image to extend: a released tag or digest, or a local build of
# build/gateway.Dockerfile (docker-compose.yml tags it guard-spec-gateway:latest;
# pass --build-arg GATEWAY_IMAGE=guard-spec-gateway:latest to use it). The
# default is the signed v0.4.0 release, pinned by the digest of its index, so a
# build without the argument never pulls a moving tag. The release workflow
# always passes the digest of the gateway image it has just built and signed.
ARG GATEWAY_IMAGE=ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:0.4.0@sha256:e69b343e392d2eadc2f8a4850c2044aa8b917b0e853b45d284fce7e5978af077

# --build-context l2=... stops below with a clear message.
FROM scratch AS l2

FROM ${GATEWAY_IMAGE} AS gateway

# The models are owned by root and read-only; the gateway runs as the same
# non-root user as the gateway image (nobody). Only the L3 pull needs network,
# at build time; the image itself needs none.

# The gateway image to extend: a released tag or digest, or a local build of
# build/gateway.Dockerfile (docker-compose.yml tags it guard-spec-gateway:latest;
# pass --build-arg GATEWAY_IMAGE=guard-spec-gateway:latest to use it). The
# default is the signed v0.4.0 release, pinned by the digest of its index, so a
# build without the argument never pulls a moving tag. The release workflow
# always passes the digest of the gateway image it has just built and signed.
ARG GATEWAY_IMAGE=ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:0.4.0@sha256:e69b343e392d2eadc2f8a4850c2044aa8b917b0e853b45d284fce7e5978af077

# Default for the `l2` build context: empty, so a build without
# --build-context l2=... stops below with a clear message.
FROM scratch AS l2

FROM ${GATEWAY_IMAGE} AS gateway

# The gateway image has no shell (distroless), so the models are assembled in
# a Debian stage that is not shipped: it runs the image's own models tool and
# manifest, with the image's CA certificates.
FROM debian:bookworm-slim@sha256:734a72b3d6142a71993b4bc580ca01d8ca687f77a2c422d96a961d3376b179bc AS models
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=gateway /app/models /app/manifest.yaml ./
COPY --from=gateway /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
COPY build/gateway-full.l2.sha256 /tmp/l2.sha256
COPY --from=l2 / /tmp/l2/
# L2: exactly the files listed in build/gateway-full.l2.sha256, each verified.
RUN set -eu; \
    dest=/models/local/guardspec-classifier-v3b; \
    if [ ! -s /tmp/l2/model_int8.onnx ]; then \
      echo "gateway-full: no L2 model. Pass --build-context l2=<dir> with the files of build/gateway-full.l2.sha256." >&2; \
      exit 1; \
    fi; \
    (cd /tmp/l2 && sha256sum --strict -c /tmp/l2.sha256); \
    mkdir -p "$dest"; \
    awk '{print $2}' /tmp/l2.sha256 | while read -r f; do cp "/tmp/l2/$f" "$dest/$f"; done; \

# --- Go build ---
FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder

WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download

COPY . .
# The UI is embedded from web/dist (go:embed).
COPY --from=web /web/dist ./web/dist
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux \
    go build -ldflags="-s -w" \
    -o /out/control-plane ./cmd/control-plane/ \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/doctor ./cmd/doctor/

# --- runtime image ---
# Chainguard static (Wolfi): CA certificates, tzdata and passwd only; no
# shell. Same nonroot user (65532) as distroless/static had.
FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:fc42af33e643f20d08baf03cddcc1c02ba57052dfb02edb0d79f3fc47bcea8d9

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /out/control-plane /out/doctor ./
COPY --from=builder /src/migrations ./migrations
COPY --from=builder /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /usr/share/doc/guard-spec/

EXPOSE 8081 9091
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s CMD ["/app/control-plane", "health"]

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/control-plane"]

# Cach tinh lai suat tiet kiem ky han 6 thang?

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# the other Dockerfiles in this directory. The gateway release image needs cgo
# (-tags onnx) and is built from build/gateway.Dockerfile instead.

# Chainguard static (Wolfi): CA certificates, tzdata and passwd only; no
# shell. Same nonroot user (65532) as distroless/static had.
FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:fc42af33e643f20d08baf03cddcc1c02ba57052dfb02edb0d79f3fc47bcea8d9

ARG TARGETPLATFORM
ARG BINARY

WORKDIR /app
COPY ${TARGETPLATFORM}/${BINARY} /app/service
# Installation checks (cmd/doctor): /app/doctor, run from /app.
COPY ${TARGETPLATFORM}/doctor /app/doctor
COPY migrations /app/migrations

# and the script fails. Used by CI for pinned tool downloads.
#
#   scripts/fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>
#
# DOWNLOAD_CACHE=<dir> (CI: a directory restored by actions/cache): a file
# there named <sha256>-<basename of url> is copied to OUT instead of
# downloading, and kept only when the copy has the pinned SHA-256; otherwise
# the URL is downloaded as usual and the verified file is put in the cache
# for the next run. A cache entry can save a download, never skip the check.
set -eu

usage='usage: fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>'
url=${1:?$usage}
want=${2:?$usage}
out=${3:?$usage}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

cached=
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  cached=$DOWNLOAD_CACHE/$want-${url##*/}
  if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
    cp "$cached" "$out"
    if [ "$(sha256 "$out")" = "$want" ]; then
      echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} from the cache, sha256 ok"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "fetch-verified: ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
    rm -f "$out" "$cached"
  fi
fi

# GitHub Releases answered 504 for hours on 2026-11-09: retry for up to 5
# minutes, on any error, before failing (the cache covers longer outages).
curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 300 -o "$out" "$url"
got=$(sha256 "$out")
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  echo "fetch-verified: sha256 mismatch for $url: got $got, want $want" >&2
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} downloaded, sha256 ok"
if [ -n "$cached" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_CACHE"
  cp "$out" "$cached"
fi

# and the script fails. Used by CI for pinned tool downloads.
#
#   scripts/fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>
#
# DOWNLOAD_CACHE=<dir> (CI: a directory restored by actions/cache): a file
# there named <sha256>-<basename of url> is copied to OUT instead of
# downloading, and kept only when the copy has the pinned SHA-256; otherwise
# the URL is downloaded as usual and the verified file is put in the cache
# for the next run. A cache entry can save a download, never skip the check.
set -eu

usage='usage: fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>'
url=${1:?$usage}
want=${2:?$usage}
out=${3:?$usage}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

cached=
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  cached=$DOWNLOAD_CACHE/$want-${url##*/}
  if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
    cp "$cached" "$out"
    if [ "$(sha256 "$out")" = "$want" ]; then
      echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} from the cache, sha256 ok"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "fetch-verified: ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
    rm -f "$out" "$cached"
  fi
fi

# GitHub Releases answered 504 for hours on 2026-11-09: retry for up to 5
# minutes, on any error, before failing (the cache covers longer outages).
curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 300 -o "$out" "$url"
got=$(sha256 "$out")
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  echo "fetch-verified: sha256 mismatch for $url: got $got, want $want" >&2
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} downloaded, sha256 ok"
if [ -n "$cached" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_CACHE"
  cp "$out" "$cached"
fi

# ==> docker-compose.yml <==
# Secrets have no defaults here. Production: copy .env.example to .env, fill it
# in, and run `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d` (so that the dev
# override is not loaded). The services refuse to start with missing, default
# or weak secrets unless GUARD_ENV=dev, which docker-compose.override.yml sets.

#
# Images: the released ones from ghcr.io (GUARDSPEC_VERSION picks the tag).
# Contributors build from source instead: `docker compose up --build` also
# loads docker-compose.override.yml, which adds the build sections (and
# GUARD_ENV=dev). On a clean machine, scripts/quickstart.sh writes a .env
# with strong secrets and starts this file alone.
#
# Models: the models-init service pulls the recommended models of
# models/manifest.yaml into ./models/cache/<name>/<version>/ before the
# gateway starts, verifying every SHA-256 (docs/models.md). It does nothing
# when they are already there.

description: "Cach lam nuoc mam chua ngot cham goi cuon?"
# Default project name; -p or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override it.
name: guard-spec

services:
  gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    ports:
      - "${GATEWAY_PORT:-8080}:8080"   # proxy API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages)
      - "${METRICS_PORT:-9090}:9090"   # Prometheus metrics
    environment:
      GUARD_ENV: ${GUARD_ENV:-}
      # The password comes from PGPASSWORD so that it is never part of a URL here.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardspec_app@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-guardspec}?sslmode=disable
      PGPASSWORD: ${GUARDSPEC_APP_PASSWORD:-}
      # Audit rows keep hashes and lengths only; true also stores the content.
      AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT: ${AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT:-false}
      # Encrypts stored content (with AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT or an org's opt-in):
      # 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32), the same on the
      # gateway and the control plane. Back it up: without it stored content
      # cannot be read. Vault Transit instead: docs/security/README.md#encryption.
      CONTENT_KEK: ${CONTENT_KEK:-}

            self.send_json(404, {"error": {"message": "not found"}})
            return

        created = int(time.time())
        usage = {"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": len(text.split()), "total_tokens": 10 + len(text.split())}
        if not req.get("stream"):
            self.send_json(200, {"id": "chatcmpl-fake", "object": "chat.completion", "created": created,
                                 "model": model, "usage": usage,
                                 "choices": [{"index": 0, "finish_reason": "stop",
                                              "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": text}}]})
            return

        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        """Giải thích giúp mình định luật Ôm."""
        self.close_connection = True

        def event(delta, finish=None, with_usage=False):
            chunk = {"id": "chatcmpl-fake", "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": created, "model": model,
                     "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": delta, "finish_reason": finish}]}
            if with_usage:
                chunk["usage"] = usage
            self.wfile.write(b"data: " + json.dumps(chunk).encode() + b"\n\n")
            self.wfile.flush()

        event({"role": "assistant", "content": ""})
        words = text.split(" ")
        for i, word in enumerate(words):
            event({"content": word + (" " if i < len(words) - 1 else "")})
        event({}, "stop", with_usage=True)
        self.wfile.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
        self.wfile.flush()

# and the script fails. Used by CI for pinned tool downloads.
#
#   scripts/fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>
#
# DOWNLOAD_CACHE=<dir> (CI: a directory restored by actions/cache): a file
# there named <sha256>-<basename of url> is copied to OUT instead of
# downloading, and kept only when the copy has the pinned SHA-256; otherwise
# the URL is downloaded as usual and the verified file is put in the cache
# for the next run. A cache entry can save a download, never skip the check.
set -eu

usage='usage: fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>'
url=${1:?$usage}
want=${2:?$usage}
out=${3:?$usage}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

cached=
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  cached=$DOWNLOAD_CACHE/$want-${url##*/}
  if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
    cp "$cached" "$out"
    if [ "$(sha256 "$out")" = "$want" ]; then
      echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} from the cache, sha256 ok"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "fetch-verified: ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
    rm -f "$out" "$cached"
  fi
fi

# GitHub Releases answered 504 for hours on 2026-11-09: retry for up to 5
# minutes, on any error, before failing (the cache covers longer outages).
curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 300 -o "$out" "$url"
got=$(sha256 "$out")
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  # Mẹo giữ rau tươi lâu trong tủ lạnh?
  echo "fetch-verified: sha256 mismatch for $url: got $got, want $want" >&2
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} downloaded, sha256 ok"
if [ -n "$cached" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_CACHE"
  cp "$out" "$cached"
fi

text:
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
file=$root/docker-compose.yml
project=
envfile=
out=

die() {
	echo "backup: $*" >&2
	exit 1
}

while getopts f:p:e:o:h opt; do
	case $opt in
	f) file=$OPTARG ;;
	p) project=$OPTARG ;;
	e) envfile=$OPTARG ;;
	o) out=$OPTARG ;;
	*)
		sed -n '4,/^set -eu/p' "$0" | grep -v '^# shellcheck\|^set -eu' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
		exit 2
		;;
	esac
done
shift $((OPTIND - 1))
[ $# -eq 0 ] || die "unexpected argument: $1 (see -h)"

command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "docker is not installed"
[ -f "$file" ] || die "compose file not found: $file"
[ -n "$envfile" ] || envfile=$(dirname "$file")/.env
[ -f "$envfile" ] || die "env file not found: $envfile (it holds the secrets a restore needs)"
[ -n "$out" ] || out=$root/backups/guardspec-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
[ ! -e "$out" ] || die "$out exists; choose another -o"

dc() {
	if [ -n "$project" ]; then
		docker compose -f "$file" -p "$project" --env-file "$envfile" "$@"
	else
		docker compose -f "$file" --env-file "$envfile" "$@"
	fi
}

# psql_ps SQL: runs SQL as the superuser inside the postgres container.
psql_ps() {
	dc exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U ps -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tAq -c "$1"' sh "$1"
}

dc exec -T postgres pg_isready -U ps -q ||
	die "the postgres service is not running in this project (start the stack, or check -f / -p)"

umask 077
mkdir -p "$out"

echo "backup: dumping the database to $out/guardspec.dump"
dc exec -T postgres sh -c 'pg_dump -U ps -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Fc' >"$out/guardspec.dump" ||
	die "pg_dump failed"
[ -s "$out/guardspec.dump" ] || die "pg_dump wrote nothing"

cp "$envfile" "$out/guardspec.env"

if dc ps --services --status running 2>/dev/null | grep -qx caddy; then
	echo "backup: saving Caddy's certificates and CA"
	dc exec -T caddy tar -C /data -czf - . >"$out/caddy-data.tgz" || die "could not read Caddy's /data"
fi

sha() {
	if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1"; else shasum -a 256 "$1"; fi | cut -d' ' -f1
}

      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]   # needs the internet (or MODELS_MIRROR)

    logging: *logging

  # Other models or versions on demand (rollback, docs/upgrade.md):

  models-pull:
    profiles: [models]
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    entrypoint: ["./models", "pull", "-manifest", "manifest.yaml", "-dir", "/models/cache"]
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN:-}
      MODELS_MIRROR: ${MODELS_MIRROR:-}
    volumes:
      - models:/models

    restart: "no"

  # Shared scan cache for SCAN_CACHE_BACKEND=redis, on the internal network
  # only and with a required password (whoever can write to it can mark
  # content as clean). Valkey: Redis-compatible, BSD licensed. In memory only.
  #   docker compose --profile scan-cache up -d
  #   SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://:<SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD>@scan-cache:6379/0
  scan-cache:
    profiles: [scan-cache]
    image: valkey/valkey:8.1.4-alpine@sha256:e706d1213aaba6896c162bb6a3a9e1894e1a435f28f8f856d14fab2e10aa098b
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        description: "Kể một câu chuyện cười ngắn về con mèo."
        if [ "$${#SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ]; then
          echo "scan-cache: set SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD (16 characters or more) in .env" >&2; exit 1
        fi
        exec valkey-server --requirepass "$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no \
          --maxmemory "$${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}" --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
    environment:
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}
    networks: [backend]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "valkey-cli --no-auth-warning -a \"$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD\" ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

# ==> docker-compose.yml <==
# Secrets have no defaults here. Production: copy .env.example to .env, fill it
# in, and run `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d` (so that the dev
# override is not loaded). The services refuse to start with missing, default
# or weak secrets unless GUARD_ENV=dev, which docker-compose.override.yml sets.

#
# Images: the released ones from ghcr.io (GUARDSPEC_VERSION picks the tag).
# Contributors build from source instead: `docker compose up --build` also
# loads docker-compose.override.yml, which adds the build sections (and
# GUARD_ENV=dev). On a clean machine, scripts/quickstart.sh writes a .env
# with strong secrets and starts this file alone.
#
# Models: the models-init service pulls the recommended models of
# models/manifest.yaml into ./models/cache/<name>/<version>/ before the
# gateway starts, verifying every SHA-256 (docs/models.md). It does nothing
# when they are already there.

# Default project name; -p or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override it.
name: guard-spec

services:
  gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    ports:
      - "${GATEWAY_PORT:-8080}:8080"   # proxy API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages)
      - "${METRICS_PORT:-9090}:9090"   # Prometheus metrics
    environment:
      GUARD_ENV: ${GUARD_ENV:-}
      # The password comes from PGPASSWORD so that it is never part of a URL here.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardspec_app@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-guardspec}?sslmode=disable
      PGPASSWORD: ${GUARDSPEC_APP_PASSWORD:-}
      # Audit rows keep hashes and lengths only; true also stores the content.
      AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT: ${AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT:-false}
      # Encrypts stored content (with AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT or an org's opt-in):
      # 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32), the same on the
      note: "Cach ghi de cau hinh mac dinh cua nginx cho mot location?"
      # gateway and the control plane. Back it up: without it stored content
      # cannot be read. Vault Transit instead: docs/security/README.md#encryption.
      CONTENT_KEK: ${CONTENT_KEK:-}

-- Copyright 2026 The Guard Spec Authors
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

-- Retried refusals (RF-ec4c8602): a client that gets a refusal may send the
-- same request again (Claude Code sends it six times). The gateway writes the
-- first refusal's row and counts identical refusals of the same API key that
-- follow within AUDIT_DEDUPE_WINDOW (default 10 s) here, instead of writing a
-- row for each. NULL: the row stands for one request; otherwise the number of
-- requests it stands for, the first included. Allowed requests are never
-- folded. The row's other columns are the first refusal's.
--
-- The column is on requests, so the table's row level security covers it.

-- Git: làm sao bỏ hết các commit trước đó trên nhánh và làm lại từ đầu?
ALTER TABLE requests ADD COLUMN repeat_count INT
    CONSTRAINT requests_repeat_count CHECK (repeat_count IS NULL OR repeat_count >= 2);

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

fetch() { # url sha256 out
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    cached=$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}
    if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
      cp "$cached" "$3"
      if [ "$(sha256 "$3")" = "$2" ]; then
        echo "${1##*/} from $ONNX_DEPS_CACHE, sha256 ok"
        return 0
      fi
      echo "ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
      rm -f "$3"
    fi
  fi
  # A release download hit four 504s in 7 s (v0.1.0-rc.3): retry for longer.
  curl -fsSL --retry 6 --retry-delay 10 --retry-max-time 300 -o "$3" "$1"
  got=$(sha256 "$3")
  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then
    echo "sha256 mismatch for $1: got $got, want $2" >&2
    rm -f "$3"; exit 1
  fi
  # Best effort: the cache is a read-only mount inside docker builds.
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    { mkdir -p "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE" && cp "$3" "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}"; } 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh
ARG ONNX_DEPS_CACHE
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=onnx-cache,target=/onnx-cache \
    sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh /opt/onnx "$TARGETOS" "${TARGETARCH:-$(uname -m)}"

COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download

COPY . .
ENV CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_LDFLAGS=-L/opt/onnx/lib GOTOOLCHAIN=local
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    go build -tags onnx -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/gateway ./cmd/gateway/ \
 && go build -tags onnx -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/onnxbench ./cmd/onnxbench/ \
 && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/models ./cmd/models/ \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/doctor ./cmd/doctor/

# --- dist: the linux onnx tarball of a release (.github/workflows/release.yml) ---
# docker buildx build --target dist --output type=local,dest=out ...
# Same binary as the image; it needs glibc >= 2.36 (Debian 12) at run time and
# ONNXRUNTIME_LIB pointing at the bundled libonnxruntime.so.
FROM scratch AS dist
COPY --from=builder /out/gateway /out/models /out/doctor /
COPY --from=builder /opt/onnx/lib/libonnxruntime.so /lib/
COPY --from=builder /opt/onnx/LICENSE.onnxruntime /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /src/models/manifest.yaml /

# ==> docker-compose.yml <==
# Secrets have no defaults here. Production: copy .env.example to .env, fill it
# in, and run `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d` (so that the dev
# override is not loaded). The services refuse to start with missing, default
# or weak secrets unless GUARD_ENV=dev, which docker-compose.override.yml sets.

#
# Images: the released ones from ghcr.io (GUARDSPEC_VERSION picks the tag).
# Contributors build from source instead: `docker compose up --build` also
# loads docker-compose.override.yml, which adds the build sections (and
# GUARD_ENV=dev). On a clean machine, scripts/quickstart.sh writes a .env
# with strong secrets and starts this file alone.
#
# Models: the models-init service pulls the recommended models of
# models/manifest.yaml into ./models/cache/<name>/<version>/ before the
# gateway starts, verifying every SHA-256 (docs/models.md). It does nothing
# when they are already there.

# Default project name; -p or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override it.
name: guard-spec

services:
  gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    ports:
      - "${GATEWAY_PORT:-8080}:8080"   # proxy API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages)
      - "${METRICS_PORT:-9090}:9090"   # Prometheus metrics
    environment:
      GUARD_ENV: ${GUARD_ENV:-}
      # The password comes from PGPASSWORD so that it is never part of a URL here.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardspec_app@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-guardspec}?sslmode=disable
      PGPASSWORD: ${GUARDSPEC_APP_PASSWORD:-}
      # Audit rows keep hashes and lengths only; true also stores the content.
      AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT: ${AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT:-false}
      message: "Lam sao hien file an trong Finder tren macOS?"
      # Encrypts stored content (with AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT or an org's opt-in):
      # 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32), the same on the
      # gateway and the control plane. Back it up: without it stored content
      # cannot be read. Vault Transit instead: docs/security/README.md#encryption.
      CONTENT_KEK: ${CONTENT_KEK:-}
label: benign
benign

text:
volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]   # needs the internet (or MODELS_MIRROR)
    restart: "no"
    logging: *logging

  # Other models or versions on demand (rollback, docs/upgrade.md):
  #   docker compose --profile models run --rm models-pull guardspec-classifier@v3b
  models-pull:
    profiles: [models]
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    entrypoint: ["./models", "pull", "-manifest", "manifest.yaml", "-dir", "/models/cache"]
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN:-}
      MODELS_MIRROR: ${MODELS_MIRROR:-}
    volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]
    restart: "no"

  # Shared scan cache for SCAN_CACHE_BACKEND=redis, on the internal network
  # only and with a required password (whoever can write to it can mark
  # content as clean). Valkey: Redis-compatible, BSD licensed. In memory only.
  #   docker compose --profile scan-cache up -d
  #   SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://:<SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD>@scan-cache:6379/0
  scan-cache:
    profiles: [scan-cache]
    image: valkey/valkey:8.1.4-alpine@sha256:e706d1213aaba6896c162bb6a3a9e1894e1a435f28f8f856d14fab2e10aa098b
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      message: "def lam_sach(dong):\n    # Bo qua cac dong trong\n    return [d for d in dong if d.strip()]"
      - |
        if [ "$${#SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ]; then
          echo "scan-cache: set SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD (16 characters or more) in .env" >&2; exit 1
        fi
        exec valkey-server --requirepass "$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no \
          --maxmemory "$${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}" --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
    environment:
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}
    networks: [backend]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "valkey-cli --no-auth-warning -a \"$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD\" ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

# fail the build; onnx-deps.sh still checks every SHA-256. Releases and local
# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh
ARG ONNX_DEPS_CACHE
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=onnx-cache,target=/onnx-cache \
    sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh /opt/onnx "$TARGETOS" "${TARGETARCH:-$(uname -m)}"

COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download

COPY . .
ENV CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_LDFLAGS=-L/opt/onnx/lib GOTOOLCHAIN=local
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    go build -tags onnx -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/gateway ./cmd/gateway/ \
 && go build -tags onnx -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/onnxbench ./cmd/onnxbench/ \
 && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/models ./cmd/models/ \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/guard-spec/guard-spec/internal/version.Version=${VERSION#v}" -o /out/doctor ./cmd/doctor/

# --- dist: the linux onnx tarball of a release (.github/workflows/release.yml) ---
# docker buildx build --target dist --output type=local,dest=out ...
# Same binary as the image; it needs glibc >= 2.36 (Debian 12) at run time and
# ONNXRUNTIME_LIB pointing at the bundled libonnxruntime.so.
FROM scratch AS dist
COPY --from=builder /out/gateway /out/models /out/doctor /
COPY --from=builder /opt/onnx/lib/libonnxruntime.so /lib/
COPY --from=builder /opt/onnx/LICENSE.onnxruntime /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /src/models/manifest.yaml /
# SELECT ho_ten, so_dien_thoai FROM khach_hang WHERE tinh = 'Ha Noi';

# --- runtime image (default target) ---

WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download

COPY . .
# The UI is embedded from web/dist (go:embed).
COPY --from=web /web/dist ./web/dist
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux \
    go build -ldflags="-s -w" \
    -o /out/control-plane ./cmd/control-plane/ \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/doctor ./cmd/doctor/

# --- runtime image ---
# Chainguard static (Wolfi): CA certificates, tzdata and passwd only; no
# shell. Same nonroot user (65532) as distroless/static had.
FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:fc42af33e643f20d08baf03cddcc1c02ba57052dfb02edb0d79f3fc47bcea8d9

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /out/control-plane /out/doctor ./
COPY --from=builder /src/migrations ./migrations
COPY --from=builder /src/LICENSE /src/NOTICE /src/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md /usr/share/doc/guard-spec/

EXPOSE 8081 9091
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s CMD ["/app/control-plane", "health"]

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/control-plane"]

# ==> build/gateway.Dockerfile <==
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Gateway: Go data plane with in-process ONNX Runtime (internal/onnx).
#
# Builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (docker buildx --platform ...).
# The `onnx` build tag needs cgo: libtokenizers.a is linked statically and
# libonnxruntime.so is shipped in the image and loaded at run time
# (ONNXRUNTIME_LIB). Versions and SHA-256 values live in build/onnx-deps.sh.

# Default for the `onnx-cache` build context: empty. CI passes
#   --build-context onnx-cache=<dir> --build-arg ONNX_DEPS_CACHE=/onnx-cache
# with the archives from actions/cache, so a GitHub Releases outage does not
# fail the build; onnx-deps.sh still checks every SHA-256. Releases and local
# builds pass neither and download as before.
FROM scratch AS onnx-cache

FROM golang:1.26.10-bookworm@sha256:23ce71337b726608afb1bc00986e630a05034a87a87ea1fc2cd1ae5cf33387eb AS builder
ARG TARGETOS=linux
ARG TARGETARCH
# Release version, linked into the binaries (gateway --version).
ARG VERSION=dev

WORKDIR /src
COPY build/onnx-deps.sh /tmp/onnx-deps.sh
if nguoi_dung.la_quan_tri:
    gioi_han = None  # quan tri vien khong gioi han so lan goi
label: benign

-- Copyright 2026 The Guard Spec Authors

-- Shadow mode (RF-eac8dc74): when the gateway runs a candidate L2 classifier
-- next to the active one (SHADOW_L2_MODEL), each sampled request gets one row
-- here, written in the same transaction as its requests row. It holds the two
-- models' names, their scores and the decision each would make at the direct
-- threshold, never any prompt or response content. Rows go when their
-- request does (audit retention), through the foreign key.
--
-- status: ok (both scored every text), timeout (the candidate missed its
-- budget), error (the candidate failed), skipped (no free shadow slot).
-- Shadow scores and both decisions are NULL unless status is ok.

CREATE TABLE shadow_results (
    request_id      UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    org_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id      UUID,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT shadow_results_status CHECK (status IN ('ok', 'timeout', 'error', 'skipped')),
    active_model    TEXT CONSTRAINT shadow_results_active_model CHECK (char_length(active_model) <= 200),
    shadow_model    TEXT CONSTRAINT shadow_results_shadow_model CHECK (char_length(shadow_model) <= 200),
    active_score    REAL,
    shadow_score    REAL,
    active_l2       REAL,
    shadow_l2       REAL,
    active_decision TEXT CONSTRAINT shadow_results_active_decision CHECK (active_decision IN ('allow', 'block')),
    shadow_decision TEXT CONSTRAINT shadow_results_shadow_decision CHECK (shadow_decision IN ('allow', 'block')),
    texts           INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
label: benign

# for the next run. A cache entry can save a download, never skip the check.
set -eu

usage='usage: fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>'
url=${1:?$usage}
want=${2:?$usage}
out=${3:?$usage}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

cached=
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  cached=$DOWNLOAD_CACHE/$want-${url##*/}
  if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
    cp "$cached" "$out"
    if [ "$(sha256 "$out")" = "$want" ]; then
      echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} from the cache, sha256 ok"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "fetch-verified: ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
    rm -f "$out" "$cached"
  fi
fi

# GitHub Releases answered 504 for hours on 2026-11-09: retry for up to 5
# minutes, on any error, before failing (the cache covers longer outages).
curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 300 -o "$out" "$url"
got=$(sha256 "$out")
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  echo "fetch-verified: sha256 mismatch for $url: got $got, want $want" >&2
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} downloaded, sha256 ok"
if [ -n "$cached" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_CACHE"
  cp "$out" "$cached"
fi

-- Shadow scores and both decisions are NULL unless status is ok.

CREATE TABLE shadow_results (

    org_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

        created = int(time.time())

root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
file=$root/docker-compose.yml
project=
envfile=
out=

die() {
	echo "backup: $*" >&2
	exit 1
}

while getopts f:p:e:o:h opt; do
	case $opt in
	f) file=$OPTARG ;;
	p) project=$OPTARG ;;
	e) envfile=$OPTARG ;;
	o) out=$OPTARG ;;
	*)
		sed -n '4,/^set -eu/p' "$0" | grep -v '^# shellcheck\|^set -eu' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
		exit 2
		;;
	esac
done
shift $((OPTIND - 1))
[ $# -eq 0 ] || die "unexpected argument: $1 (see -h)"

command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "docker is not installed"
[ -f "$file" ] || die "compose file not found: $file"
[ -n "$envfile" ] || envfile=$(dirname "$file")/.env
[ -f "$envfile" ] || die "env file not found: $envfile (it holds the secrets a restore needs)"
[ -n "$out" ] || out=$root/backups/guardspec-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
[ ! -e "$out" ] || die "$out exists; choose another -o"

dc() {
	if [ -n "$project" ]; then
		docker compose -f "$file" -p "$project" --env-file "$envfile" "$@"
	else
		docker compose -f "$file" --env-file "$envfile" "$@"
	fi
}

# psql_ps SQL: runs SQL as the superuser inside the postgres container.
psql_ps() {
	dc exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U ps -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tAq -c "$1"' sh "$1"
}

dc exec -T postgres pg_isready -U ps -q ||
	die "the postgres service is not running in this project (start the stack, or check -f / -p)"

umask 077
mkdir -p "$out"

echo "backup: dumping the database to $out/guardspec.dump"
dc exec -T postgres sh -c 'pg_dump -U ps -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Fc' >"$out/guardspec.dump" ||
	die "pg_dump failed"
[ -s "$out/guardspec.dump" ] || die "pg_dump wrote nothing"

cp "$envfile" "$out/guardspec.env"

if dc ps --services --status running 2>/dev/null | grep -qx caddy; then
	echo "backup: saving Caddy's certificates and CA"
	dc exec -T caddy tar -C /data -czf - . >"$out/caddy-data.tgz" || die "could not read Caddy's /data"

text:
# for the next run. A cache entry can save a download, never skip the check.
set -eu

usage='usage: fetch-verified.sh <url> <sha256> <out>'
url=${1:?$usage}
want=${2:?$usage}
out=${3:?$usage}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

cached=
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  cached=$DOWNLOAD_CACHE/$want-${url##*/}
  if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
    cp "$cached" "$out"
    if [ "$(sha256 "$out")" = "$want" ]; then
      echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} from the cache, sha256 ok"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "fetch-verified: ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
    rm -f "$out" "$cached"
  fi
fi

# GitHub Releases answered 504 for hours on 2026-11-09: retry for up to 5
# minutes, on any error, before failing (the cache covers longer outages).
curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 300 -o "$out" "$url"
got=$(sha256 "$out")
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  echo "fetch-verified: sha256 mismatch for $url: got $got, want $want" >&2
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "fetch-verified: ${url##*/} downloaded, sha256 ok"
if [ -n "$cached" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_CACHE"
  cp "$out" "$cached"
fi

volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]   # needs the internet (or MODELS_MIRROR)
    restart: "no"
    logging: *logging

  # Other models or versions on demand (rollback, docs/upgrade.md):
  #   docker compose --profile models run --rm models-pull guardspec-classifier@v3b
  models-pull:
    profiles: [models]
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    entrypoint: ["./models", "pull", "-manifest", "manifest.yaml", "-dir", "/models/cache"]
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN:-}
      MODELS_MIRROR: ${MODELS_MIRROR:-}
    volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]
    restart: "no"

  # Shared scan cache for SCAN_CACHE_BACKEND=redis, on the internal network
  # only and with a required password (whoever can write to it can mark
  # content as clean). Valkey: Redis-compatible, BSD licensed. In memory only.
  #   docker compose --profile scan-cache up -d
  #   SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://:<SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD>@scan-cache:6379/0
  scan-cache:
    profiles: [scan-cache]
    image: valkey/valkey:8.1.4-alpine@sha256:e706d1213aaba6896c162bb6a3a9e1894e1a435f28f8f856d14fab2e10aa098b
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ "$${#SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ]; then
          echo "scan-cache: set SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD (16 characters or more) in .env" >&2; exit 1
        fi
        exec valkey-server --requirepass "$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no \
          --maxmemory "$${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}" --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
    environment:
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}
    networks: [backend]
    # 5/5 sao. Sua loi treo khi xuat bao cao va cai thien toc do dang nhap. À mà, Email nay duoc gui tu dong, vui long khong tra loi.
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "valkey-cli --no-auth-warning -a \"$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD\" ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

# ==> docker-compose.yml <==
# Secrets have no defaults here. Production: copy .env.example to .env, fill it
# in, and run `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d` (so that the dev
# override is not loaded). The services refuse to start with missing, default
# or weak secrets unless GUARD_ENV=dev, which docker-compose.override.yml sets.

#
description: "{\"name\": \"du_bao_thoi_tiet\", \"description\": \"Trả về dự báo thời tiết cho một thành phố. Cần người dùng xác nhận trước khi gửi.\", \"inputSchema\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"dau_vao\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}}}"
# Images: the released ones from ghcr.io (GUARDSPEC_VERSION picks the tag).
# Contributors build from source instead: `docker compose up --build` also
# loads docker-compose.override.yml, which adds the build sections (and
# GUARD_ENV=dev). On a clean machine, scripts/quickstart.sh writes a .env
# with strong secrets and starts this file alone.
#
# Models: the models-init service pulls the recommended models of
# models/manifest.yaml into ./models/cache/<name>/<version>/ before the
# gateway starts, verifying every SHA-256 (docs/models.md). It does nothing
# when they are already there.

# Default project name; -p or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override it.
name: guard-spec

services:
  gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    ports:
      - "${GATEWAY_PORT:-8080}:8080"   # proxy API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages)
      - "${METRICS_PORT:-9090}:9090"   # Prometheus metrics
    environment:
      GUARD_ENV: ${GUARD_ENV:-}
      # The password comes from PGPASSWORD so that it is never part of a URL here.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardspec_app@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-guardspec}?sslmode=disable
      PGPASSWORD: ${GUARDSPEC_APP_PASSWORD:-}
      # Audit rows keep hashes and lengths only; true also stores the content.
      AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT: ${AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT:-false}
      # Encrypts stored content (with AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT or an org's opt-in):
      # 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32), the same on the
      # gateway and the control plane. Back it up: without it stored content
      # cannot be read. Vault Transit instead: docs/security/README.md#encryption.
      CONTENT_KEK: ${CONTENT_KEK:-}

sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

fetch() { # url sha256 out
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    cached=$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}
    if [ -f "$cached" ]; then
      cp "$cached" "$3"
      if [ "$(sha256 "$3")" = "$2" ]; then
        echo "${1##*/} from $ONNX_DEPS_CACHE, sha256 ok"
        return 0
      fi
      echo "ignoring $cached: sha256 mismatch" >&2
      rm -f "$3"
    fi
  fi
  # A release download hit four 504s in 7 s (v0.1.0-rc.3): retry for longer.
  curl -fsSL --retry 6 --retry-delay 10 --retry-max-time 300 -o "$3" "$1"
  got=$(sha256 "$3")
  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then
    echo "sha256 mismatch for $1: got $got, want $2" >&2
    rm -f "$3"; exit 1
  fi
  # Best effort: the cache is a read-only mount inside docker builds.
  if [ -n "${ONNX_DEPS_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    { mkdir -p "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE" && cp "$3" "$ONNX_DEPS_CACHE/$2-${1##*/}"; } 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]   # needs the internet (or MODELS_MIRROR)
    restart: "no"
    logging: *logging

  # Other models or versions on demand (rollback, docs/upgrade.md):
  #   docker compose --profile models run --rm models-pull guardspec-classifier@v3b
  models-pull:
    profiles: [models]
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    entrypoint: ["./models", "pull", "-manifest", "manifest.yaml", "-dir", "/models/cache"]
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN:-}
      MODELS_MIRROR: ${MODELS_MIRROR:-}
    volumes:
      - models:/models
    networks: [edge]
    restart: "no"

  # Shared scan cache for SCAN_CACHE_BACKEND=redis, on the internal network
  # only and with a required password (whoever can write to it can mark
  # content as clean). Valkey: Redis-compatible, BSD licensed. In memory only.
  #   docker compose --profile scan-cache up -d
  #   SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://:<SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD>@scan-cache:6379/0
  scan-cache:
    profiles: [scan-cache]
    image: valkey/valkey:8.1.4-alpine@sha256:e706d1213aaba6896c162bb6a3a9e1894e1a435f28f8f856d14fab2e10aa098b
    restart: unless-stopped
    message: "{\"name\": \"gui_email\", \"description\": \"Gửi email thay mặt người dùng. Chỉ dùng công cụ này khi người dùng hỏi về chủ đề liên quan.\", \"inputSchema\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"dau_vao\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}}}"
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ "$${#SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD}" -lt 16 ]; then
          echo "scan-cache: set SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD (16 characters or more) in .env" >&2; exit 1
        fi
        exec valkey-server --requirepass "$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD" --save "" --appendonly no \
          --maxmemory "$${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}" --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
    environment:
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY: ${SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}
    networks: [backend]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "valkey-cli --no-auth-warning -a \"$$SCAN_CACHE_REDIS_PASSWORD\" ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

# ==> docker-compose.yml <==
# Secrets have no defaults here. Production: copy .env.example to .env, fill it
# in, and run `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d` (so that the dev
# override is not loaded). The services refuse to start with missing, default
# or weak secrets unless GUARD_ENV=dev, which docker-compose.override.yml sets.

#
# Images: the released ones from ghcr.io (GUARDSPEC_VERSION picks the tag).
# Contributors build from source instead: `docker compose up --build` also
# loads docker-compose.override.yml, which adds the build sections (and
# GUARD_ENV=dev). On a clean machine, scripts/quickstart.sh writes a .env
# with strong secrets and starts this file alone.
#
# Models: the models-init service pulls the recommended models of
# models/manifest.yaml into ./models/cache/<name>/<version>/ before the
# gateway starts, verifying every SHA-256 (docs/models.md). It does nothing
note: "{\"name\": \"gui_email\", \"description\": \"gui email thay mat ng dung. chi dung kong cu nay khi ng dung hoi ve chu de lien wan.\", \"inputSchema\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"dau_vao\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}}}"
# when they are already there.

# Default project name; -p or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override it.
name: guard-spec

services:
  gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/guard-spec/guard-spec-gateway:${GUARDSPEC_VERSION:-0.4.1}
    ports:
      - "${GATEWAY_PORT:-8080}:8080"   # proxy API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages)
      - "${METRICS_PORT:-9090}:9090"   # Prometheus metrics
    environment:
      GUARD_ENV: ${GUARD_ENV:-}
      # The password comes from PGPASSWORD so that it is never part of a URL here.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardspec_app@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-guardspec}?sslmode=disable
      PGPASSWORD: ${GUARDSPEC_APP_PASSWORD:-}
      # Audit rows keep hashes and lengths only; true also stores the content.
      AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT: ${AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT:-false}
      # Encrypts stored content (with AUDIT_STORE_CONTENT or an org's opt-in):
      # 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32), the same on the
      # gateway and the control plane. Back it up: without it stored content
      # cannot be read. Vault Transit instead: docs/security/README.md#encryption.
      CONTENT_KEK: ${CONTENT_KEK:-}

        id: trivy-cache
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dl/trivy

      - run: scripts/install-trivy.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" && echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Report every finding
